purpose: Publish the chain-of-title register and the AI-assisted provenance disclosure, recording contributor rights status and AI tooling involvement honestly without asserting ownership that no document supports.
requiredInvariants: No contributor may be marked RESOLVED without a referenced signed instrument; none exists, so all remain UNRESOLVED.
Contracts, personal documents and raw email addresses must never be stored in Git; only references, SHA-256 hashes and statuses.
AI tooling involvement must be disclosed, not hidden, including the vendor and commit count.
No file may be relabelled first-party on the strength of AI authorship.
Every figure must name the exact source SHA it was measured on.
Qwen remains THIRD_PARTY_INFRASTRUCTURE and must never be presented as the rights holder's own model.
No product code, dependency, workflow or production configuration may change.
Merge and CI success are not REG.RU production deployment evidence.
acceptance: All 21 contributor identities are classified and carry a rights status.
Commit counts across the register sum to the analysed history exactly (23235).
The third-party individual contributor and the unattributed local identity are both escalated as HUMAN_LEGAL_ACTION_REQUIRED.
AI involvement is disclosed for both vendors with commit counts.
CONTRIBUTORS.csv publishes email SHA-256 only, never a raw address.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the four authorized paths.
